message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No confirmed vulnerabilities newly reported in the last 24 hours directly affect the monitored products.

Coverage note: the public CVE List and GitHub Advisory Database were checked for the window from 2026-08-02 05:10 IST to 2026-08-03 05:10 IST. General web search was unavailable during this run, so vendor-only notices not yet represented in those feeds may be missing.

Fresh records for similarly named or adjacent products were excluded after product-level review, including unrelated WordPress plugins, FreeRDP (not XRDP), ArcadeDB (not MongoDB), and third-party Node.js ecosystem packages (not the Node.js runtime). No credible MongoDB-family or other uncertain product-family matches remained for review.

No immediate review is recommended based on confirmed relevance and reported severity. Continue normal patch and advisory monitoring.
